intent: Adoption guide pages and release-ready README

title: Hold the README on the 0.2.0 path; ship a ready-to-swap README and a release checklist
why: v0.2.0 is the latest release and has neither the launcher nor inject in its tools image or a CLI asset, so a README describing the annotation path would give commands that cannot work yet. The draft was checked against the CLI built from main; only the 0.2.5 tags cannot resolve before release.
alternative: Rewrite the README now with an unreleased note - rejected by the maintainer; it would describe commands users cannot run

title: Document three required annotations, not two
why: The shipped injector stops with 'missing warmup.mnemo.io/exit-mode', so the agreed two-annotation quickstart would fail on first use; the guide states what ships and the gap.
alternative: Keep the two-annotation draft - rejected: promises behaviour that is not shipped

title: Move the Helm-subchart setup to docs/helm-chart.md and split the rest into focused pages
why: The README becomes a short route to the annotation path; the chart wiring is kept intact for shell-based images and explicit templates, and each topic has one home that other pages link to instead of repeating.
alternative: Keep one long README with both setups - rejected: 400 lines and two setups side by side

title: Record the trainer ServiceAccount gap instead of papering over it
why: The injector generates the trainer ServiceAccount with no annotation hook, so the EKS push-role annotation needs a user patch; the guides say so rather than implying the ECR path is turnkey.
alternative: Describe IRSA for the trainer as automatic - rejected: false for the injector today
